categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Changes peer ping timeout logic in `src/net_processing.cpp` and carries the P2P label.
categories.rationale: Prevents spurious disconnects of well-behaved peers during initial block download on constrained bandwidth. As noted in issue #35761, nodes prioritize block transfer over pings, causing downloading nodes to needlessly drop peers after a 20-minute timeout.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches `test_runner.py` only to register a new p2p functional test; p2p-specific tests belong to p2p rather than test infrastructure.
